scenario: Activation-id machinery is unnecessary per LRST.6.13 — the engine handles activation internally; authors do not manage activation IDs. A rule that emits a `scope activation` fact names no activation id and compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Lock scope activation:
    entity_id: String

schema Req scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule guarded:
    Req r
->
    emit Lock entity_id: r.entity_id
    log info "locked"
